2023-07-24
The insured's policy was reviewed and the driver listed on it is the same person who reported the collision while
turning left at an intersection. Coverage was active at the time of loss, and nothing in the file points to damage
predating the policy start.
2023-07-26
Police confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and recorded the impact as a left-turn collision.
Respondnig officers noted the vehicle positions matched the reported sequence.
2023-08-04
Scene photographs were obtained from the insured and show damage that is largely consistent with the described
impact. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main visual record of the event.
2023-09-15
The claimant, now represented by counsel, reported a concussion following the crash. The injury descriebd fits the
kind and force of a side impact of this type.
2023-11-08
Medical records show the claimant was treated in the usual manner for this kind of head injury. No prior injury to the
same body area appears in the records reviewed.
2023-11-27
The claimant gave the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, including the initial report and later
calls with the adjuster. The sequence of events has not shifted between contacts.
2023-12-06
Vehicle inspection found no sign of earlier damage to the vehicle, and the repair estimate lines up with the reported
impact. The file contains no evidence of prior collisions involving this vehicle.
2023-12-11
Treatment noets show the claimant's symptoms eased steadily over several weeks and the frequency of visits
tapered as recovery progressed. The clinical course is consistent with a typical recovery.
2024-01-13
Counsel has requested an update on the bodily injury claim and was told the file is under active review. No additional
documents were submitted with the request.
2024-02-14
Based on the policy confirmation, police report, photographs, medical records and vehicle inspection, the file is being
handled as a standard left-turn collision claim. Next step is to finalize the injury evaluatoin with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
